# Company Profile Project Guidelines

## Stack
- Laravel 12
- PHP 8+
- MySQL
- Blade
- Tailwind CSS
- Alpine.js
- Vite

## Coding Style
- Follow PSR-12.
- Use clean architecture.
- Keep controllers thin.
- Move business logic into services when appropriate.
- Use Blade Components for reusable UI.
- Use semantic HTML.
- Use Tailwind utilities.
- Write readable and maintainable code.

## UI
- Modern
- Responsive
- Clean
- Minimal
- Professional

## Features
- Home
- About
- Services
- Portfolio
- Team
- Contact
- Admin CRUD

## Rules
- Do not generate unnecessary code.
- Prefer Laravel conventions.
- Comment only when needed.
- Use descriptive variable names.
